Real preset/custom-opacity selection, no-op picker presentation, Save/relaunch/reopen, Cancel, unchanged transforms/layout, transparent persistence and largest-text unfiltered style audits verified; final captures inspected. Final verification: unsigned simulator build succeeds, 45 core tests/8 suites and 2 shell UI tests pass. Real-picker/edit journey has no functional assertion failures but fails with four contrast reports (same horizontal caption and slot-menu text in disabled/enabled scrolled audits). Default and largest-text audits pass. No filtering. Captures inspected; controlled scroll makes those unchanged labels pass fully visible. README and combined artifact revision 11 record the evidence and unresolved audit-policy decision. Remains in_progress; no commit/push.
Owner approved narrow occluded-text contrast exceptions. Implemented only for the two scrolled editor audits on iOS 26.3: exact current horizontal-caption and slot-menu StaticText labels, with both pre-audit and reported nonempty frames intersecting the navigation bar. Unknown/nil issues, other categories, visible frames and other OS versions remain unfiltered. All exception frames are retained as xcresult text attachments. Contrast runs separately from font-mutating audits; every category still runs. Same labels are asserted fully visible and pass an additional unfiltered contrast audit. Final unsigned build and all 45 core/8 suites plus 3 UI tests pass, with exactly four approved logged exceptions. Final evidence .amp/in/artifacts/native-a11y-scoped-final.xcresult and matching build/test logs; visible-label screenshot inspected. No production UI changes in this follow-up, no commit or push.
close_reason: Verified native editor draft and accessibility policy: 45 core and 3 UI tests pass, real picker/edit/save/reopen/Cancel and visible-label unfiltered contrast checks included; owner-approved exceptions limited to confirmed navigation-occluded labels on iOS 26.3.

title: Choose native app name; keep Collager provisional
description:
## Decision
No final name chosen. Keep Collager provisional; naming does not block simulator work.

## Rationale
A live Collager collage app exists. Candidate search results are not trademark, domain or App Store clearance.

## Alternatives Considered
Inlay and Patchwork are candidates; Grok reports the owner likes both. Plumgrid remains optional if the initial palette stays. Avoid irreversible branding until decided.
notes: Grok shortlist: Inlay and Patchwork are candidates, not a final choice. Grok thread reports user likes both and prefers Inlay; final choice remains open. Patchwork has nearby photo-app names. Collager collision independently verified at https://apps.apple.com/us/app/collager-photo-collage-maker/id1146746378 . No trademark/domain/App Store clearance for any candidate. Plumgrid optional if palette remains.

title: Native follow-up features and optional public distribution
description:
After the first native milestone: undo/redo, web JSON backup interoperability, fuller project management, iPad, physical-device profiling, optional iCloud only by future approval. Native smart layout, ComparePanel and ArrangementCarousel are tracked separately as long-term P4 work in collage-ios-later.1, not dropped. Public release would need Apple Developer Program membership, name clearance, privacy disclosures and optional StoreKit goodwill tips with no feature gating. No monetization SDK or membership purchase now.

## Success Criteria
Each selected follow-up has explicit scope and verified native behavior. No public distribution, cloud or monetization implementation without the required future authorization.

title: Native smart layout, comparison panel, and arrangement carousel
description:
Long-term (P4), after the first native milestone. Port the web smart-layout work: smart positioning (Vision face/saliency in place of src/lib/face-detection.ts + ml-worker-client.ts + hooks/use-smart-position.ts), layout scoring/suggestions (src/lib/layout-scoring.ts, region-merge.ts, color-intelligence.ts, photo-similarity.ts), ComparePanel (src/components/ComparePanel.tsx) and ArrangementCarousel (src/components/ArrangementCarousel.tsx). Preserve web contracts: manual edits take precedence over automatic positioning; turning Smart Position off/on explicitly reapplies; stale photo/project/mode analysis is ignored and pending automatic positioning is invalidated when manual editing begins; all analysis stays on-device. Depends on the milestone-1 CollageKit transform model (focusX/focusY, zoom, quarterTurns).

## Acceptance Criteria
Smart layout, ComparePanel and ArrangementCarousel work natively after milestone one; all analysis stays on-device, manual edits win, and stale photo/project/mode completions cannot override edits. Use the actual milestone-one model contract when implementation starts.
